notes.title: The SBot Mystery: The PvPvE star of Battle Splash 2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/b995f9636e17dae10efb813a737b07247a02765a.png

Hi everyone!

Since the released of Battle Splash 2.0, people have been asking me about whether the game feature PvPvE or not, or how to play the SBot Guidance. Thus, I decided to post it here so that people can learn more about the Robot that's been wrecking havoc in Battle Splash 2.0.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/9ffe7142ff83fd29d93d575cc2c7b7f083e11a33.png
SBot's origin
SBot is a creation of the Head of Kangara, initially considered to be a weapon and then later as Temiko Kangara's personal guardian. SBot is around 7m tall, big enough for an adult to sit inside and control it manually. SBot is also equipped with an early version of neural-network AI, which can act as auto-pilot and guidance in the absent of the pilot. 

Due to being an early version AI, SBot's AI is designed mostly for combat purpose, and although it can learn, SBot performs poorly in other areas, almost like a child trying to explore the world. Thus, when Trianga created the B.O.S.s and Battle Splash, SBot was so excited and copied itself into the game, trying to play in its own way.

It is now up to Trianga and her gang to capture this rogue SBot inside the B.O.S.s environment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/e5dc89de43acad22cd3424aaa1771df19e60fd92.jpg
SBot Guidance
Inspired by the old school Capture the Flag, the Objective of SBot Guidance is to capture the SBot to your base. Since the robot is too big to carry, players need to Weaken it first until it no longer attacks any players. After that, player needs to Touch the robot to make it travel to the player's team base.

Successfully Taking Back the SBot will score hefty bonus points to that team, but if the SBot got Taken Out then the attacking Team will also got penalized by lots of points as well. Player will also score point for their team by taken down other team's member.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/0cd239148ec74497caa3c7486b017468bc37da16.jpg
PvPvE star, and a really tough opponent too
The more players in SBot Guidance, the better. Not just in terms of "fun", but it will also unlock lots of strategies as well.

SBot is tough, really tough. It has an arm cannon that shoot a huge medium-ranged water balloon that explodes in the middle of its trajectory. Getting too close and you'll get yourself a huge splash that sends you all the way back to your base, literally! In addition, it HP and Recovery is scaled based on the number of players. And Trianga's Turret is completely useless against SBot, as it won't target that robot at all.

So seek your covers and approach carefully, but don't get carried away, or someone else might steals SBot away from you. Player can ambush SBot on its way to the other's base by Touching it, and it will change its direction to that player's base. So protect your price well, or just let the other do it then steal SBot from them, your call.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/0c245fcdcc357dc3e7133694906bab4ef46fcaa3.jpg
GL&HF
SBot is also featured in Survival, where you have to beat some of them in certain levels. It might not get as much perks as the SBot Guidance, but it's still a fearsome opponent to face against. I truly wish you can enjoy defeating it, since it's a challenge like no other.

Happy Splashing,
Hung Mai

notes.title: Battle Splash 2.0 Upcoming Update - Skin Customization
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This post will discuss about the upcoming update for Battle Splash 2.0: Skin Customizations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/9a1a6e4910197031303d7a78be6af2373abe5b09.jpg

Skins can only be obtains by playing the game. Remember those "Coin" you get from Survival Mode? Those will be used to unlock skins via a "lottery" system (or gacha banners - no real money involved).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/c6f70cb16da79581b7ec66a0a6515f151cf05335.jpg

Skins can also have plenty of Variations. Each variations is different by at least one of these factors: Meshes, Textures, and Colors Patterns. Skins will also be categorized into rarities (from worst to best):

 Common
 Rare
 Unique
 Epic
 Legendary


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/431645ac5981e37d92e323fe219719ef9fd536b3.jpg

To make the skin even more Unique, each skin will have an additional Quality value, which indicates the "tear and wear" (quality) of the skin. Those will also be categorized as such (from worst to best):

 History: this skin is already used for a long time, and will have lots of tears and wears, to the point of hardly recognizable.
 Fading Glory: this skin is used for a long time, lots of tears and wears, but still recognizable.
 Closed Companion: this skin is favored by its user pretty often, tears and wears here and there.
 Barely Worn: this skin is rarely worn, minimal tears and wears.
 Maiden Touch: this skin is straight from factory, brand new, hardly recognizable tears and wears.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/98a0830669db4f2d0a7453ff4f4974bd71f43b34.jpg

Right now, the systems are all operational, yet there are testes to be carried out, more contents to be added, and things to be polished.

Stay tuned for the upcoming update of Battle Splash 2.0!

Happy Splashing everyone!
Hung Mai

notes.title: Battle Splash: Road to 2.0 - Updates and Changes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/adfb90d1056029525ca7debc88b717da406dd874.png
What's up?

It's been 5 years already...

I still remember that night, Dec 18th of 2017, 01:00. I was sitting at my desk, tired from a day full of work, yet still trying to release Battle Splash 2.0 as intended, since all the presses had passed words. Finally, the game came up after several hours, and I was finally relieved. But that's not the end of the story...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/268a8b35e54e304c72a9724128b9a4d4afc4dbe7.gif

For the record, Battle Splash 2.0 was not intended as a commercial game from the ground up. It was my hobby project, just to see how far I can push myself forward. It was 10 years ago, I was very young, very passionate, and despites years of experience of programming (yes, I started programming when I was 14), Battle Splash 2.0 remains the hardest game I've ever created up to this day. Thus, I've made a lot of mistakes, from game development to marketing, driven from my own inexperience and over confident.

As the result, the game was not performing well for the pass 5 years. It was too big, too ambitious for one person to handle. It was more like a tech demo rather than a full feature game. The only thing that keeps me going is there are still some people who really enjoy this game. I've watched their streams, watched how the talked about it, and analyzed its features, my decisions, etc... It was really magical for me, since people understand my intentions, my passion for this game, and I really appreciate that...

However, the elephant is still in the room: what would I do from here? Well, turns out I can't keep going forever, and thing has to end, one way or another. Don't get me wrong, my time of making Battle Splash 2.0 was a fantastic time, and I never regretted making it. Yet, it's time for me to let it go...

...But not in a sense that I'll abandon this game, just that I can't invest lot of time into it. So now I decide to release Battle Splash 2.0 at this time on Sep 26th 2023, along side with some changes...

What changed?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/b0ba9cef711589bf06ca2e865ed3a08d976ff3c6.gif

The way people enjoy the game.

As of now, Battle Splash 2.0 is a whole package, and people have pay full price for it. But I've realized that the game offers less content than it should right now, and it is a huge problem. The world is different now than 5 years ago, even 2 years ago, things already drastically changed. Thus, I decide to split the game into parts: the base game and DLCs. The base game will have everything necessary for you to enjoy Battle Splash 2.0, and the DLCs will provide additional contents for it. Once you own the DLC, it's yours to keep, no additional money needed. You might have to play the game to unlock it, but there will be no real-currency involve, except for the price of the DLC itself.

Also, the base game price will get significantly drop as well, so that it will be more accessible to lots of players. I've realized that Battle Splash 2.0 really needs online play for its coop/competitive to work (through lots of play test sessions years ago)....

Which brings us to the next "giraffe" in the room as well:

What about the Early Access people who purchased the game before?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/40ebd7cee068a170b82eb40b744496050ce93024.gif

Free DLCs, just for them only!

I really, really want to thanks everyone who supports this game from day 1, and really hopes for its bright future. Yes, you! Thank you! And by thanking, I'll give away some DLCs FOR FREE, but EXCLUSIVELY to everyone who purchased the game before Sep 25th 2023. The details about the Free DLCs will be on each DLC releases, so keep an eye on the news. It'll be my token of gratitude to everyone who's been helping me improving Battle Splash 2.0!

Closing words, and any more thought?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/89abd957814e328df238c446f20c7e8822f64961.gif

Wow, it's a very long post already! I guess that's all I wanted so say. Battle Splash 2.0 was my dream. Steam was my dream. It came true, since Battle Splash 2.0 was voted "YES" when Steam Greenlight still existed. It was not a fully realized dream, yet it was a beautiful dream regardless, and I'm proud that I've made my dream come true. That said, time for me to wake up, it's been too long already, and time for a new start. This time, I think I've learnt my lesson. You will still be hearing from me and Battle Splash 2.0 soon, because I still have tons of thing with this game, and the post release will be hectic as well...

So, any thought on this matter? Or do you want to ask me anything more? I can't guarantee I will answer all, but I'll make sure I read them...

Happy Splashing everyone!

Wishing all the Bests,

Battle Splash 2.0's Creator,
Hung Mai

notes.title: Battle Splash - Road to 2.0
notes.content:
Before we begin
HI everyone, Hung Mai here,

It's been a very, very long time since the last update, which probably makes somebody wondering how the game's going these days. Well, it's still being developed atm, just got slowed down a lot since the pandemic as well as some of my personal problems... And for that, I still owe you guys an apology...

This update also marks the beginning of the end of Battle Splash 2.0 development. I've realized that the game's been taken longer than what I expected, which really taking a toll on my creative process as well as on your patient as well. To be clear, this is an EXTREMELY ENJOYABLE journey for me, as I learned a lot about how to make a PROPER, HIGH QUALITY game as well as what it takes in order to archive that, so regardless of the result, I'm extremely happy that the game has finally comes to the end. It's a dream comes true for me, even though it's not a fully realized dream.

That said, this update is NOT THE END of Battle Splash 2.0 development, at least for a while, and it's given that I will continue to support the game post-release, so bugs will still get squashed, some tweaks will still get applied at some point.

Alright, now that's out of the way, let's dive in what does this update provide:

A brand new UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/7617ad148d0a7a27940ec90a5af737b3f03eff70.jpg
The UI has been updated, so that it'll be more clear, more intuitive, and better visual... I'll let the screenshot speaks for itself:
Better UI Flow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/ce8955a398143caee32bbe3ff3d2554273a3e06f.jpg
Better HUD (with added Minimap)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/cdd1f8c27c91e4bd58af9f44bdc8f264c9323113.jpg
Better Wiki
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/fdc3c6c4859c17d2a52bcc6c7f93acc01b0fb6a5.jpg

Changed in Game Mode

Game Mode Categories:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/940785b9f68c7bb6f180a71ab5652a48f261bc28.jpg

Game Modes will now be divided into 3 Categories:

All Stars: if you're looking for pure fun experience, this is the Category for you. This will have no class restrictions as well as bullet/ammo - fun in its purest form.
Competitive: if you're looking for more challenge, comes to this battle arena. Rule will be very stricts on you, requires you to use all of your skills to become the champion.
Survival: if you're looking for a solo-singleplayer/coop experience. Battle through hordes of enemy with various rules/enemies to challenge yourself.


Introducing new Mechanic: Shop/In-game Inventory
Starting with this update, some game mode (especially Competitive ones) will have shop. You must buy your weapon there and manage your own wallet in order to purchase your favorite weapon.

To access the shop, use the key (i) on keyboard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/36d8d6cef43bf3ebaee26d3b049a15402c66eb7e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/8349b8b60264f2adc07bf4ccdaf277423cb6a789.jpg

New Feature: Key Binding (finally)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/22f59f411c0604e6df6bb6d7eeade598d842240b.jpg
From now on, you can finally change your keybinding to fit your playstyle. I did realize that this is a much needed feature, and I myself would like to include that from the start, yet the engine did not feature any feasible option to change keybinding at the time (hence the Unity start-up dialog). That said, that dialog will let you access to the safe-mode graphics option (for low specs computer), so it will be there for a longer while.

New Feature: (Almost) Full Controller Support
Options->Gameplay Settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/f5610f4d64e448bd8331273ab10d978e61dd8749.jpg
If you enjoy playing shooter on controller, fears not! Battle Splash 2.0 is now fully controller support for gameplay and partially with UI. Not only that, if you're lucky enough to own a PS4/DS5 controller, you'll be able to perform Gyro Aiming, which will drastically improve how you play the game.

Auto Analog Calibration - Anti Analog Drifting:
You have an ancient Controller? You used it too much and now it drift? You worry that you can't enjoy game with it anymore? Worry not! Since Battle Splash 2.0 will automatically adjust to your analogs reading, so that it will clamp the range for their input signal, thus reduces control drift a lot. Just plug your controller in, rotate your analogs a few times, and you're good to go (for now, you'll have to do this every time you fire up/connecting your controller).

Massive Performance Upgrade:
With the help of multithreading and lots, lots of optimizations, Battle Splash 2.0's performance has been doubled since the last time (literally goes from 40FPS to 80FPS with the recommended system). Enjoy high speed water warfare like it was meant to be, without much shuttering in the way!

Changed
Language support on hold
Since the new UI has been reworked, lots of translations got outdated and cannot be included inside the game. However, given that most of previous translations' quality isn't what I expected, those translations will be discarded until I find better translations. Since translation/localization is based on trust, this will be along process, and there might not be as much languages as it was before, so I'd like to apologize to everyone in advanced.

However, custom/user translations will still be available (in the near future). Keep in mind that I hold no responsibility for those translations, and they are to be maintained by their owners.

There are a few more updates I'd like to reveal to everyone, yet the time has not comes, so I'll see you again in the near future.

Hope you the best,

Battle Splash 2.0 Creator,
Hung Mai

notes.title: Update v1.690 - FirstPersona
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/62a019026cda4d9055166eb8398cd8ac9f60b9b0.jpg
Forewords

Hi everyone!

It's me again, Hung Mai, the sole creator of Battle Splash 2.0.

You probably haven't heard from me for quite a while, as well as there's been no update for Battle Splash 2.0 for around half a year (probably longer). Well, I think I owe you guys an apology for that.

2019 was not a great year for me. I'd been struggle with the process of map creation that I barely made any progress with the game's content. Also, I've involved in some irrelevant stuffs that cause the development of Battle Splash to slow down dramatically. For this reason, I decided that I'll let you guys involve in the development process a bit more, as an Apology from me.

Hence, this update will be a little different: it contains most of the features I've been working on for Battle Splash that are excluded from the game in each Early Access builds upto now. There were two reasons why those features did not make it into the previous builds:
[olist]
 Those Features are Experimental (to the gameplay).
 Performance, bugs, integration and stability problems
[/olist]

In orther words: you are now granted access to unfinished features of Battle Splash 2.0. Of course, there's always a catch (or two), which are:

 All Experimental features are not guaranteed to be 99% bugs-free (well, nothing's perfect). Yet rest assured, those bugs are 90% guaranteed not to be game-breaking bugs/crashes/fatal to your system. I'll list those bugs into the Known Issue segment of every update. (again, you can always submit your bugs report in the forum)
 Not 100% of the features will be included into the final game. If you one day see that your character can climb, for example, but the next day the ladder was gone and your character can no longer climb, then there's nothing I can do about it. I know this's kinda frustrating, yet sometimes that small feature will cause the entire game to be remade or introduce new bugs, or even breaking the game's balance, then there's no way that I can keep it to the final version. Of course, you can always pitch your ideas in the forum, and I'll consider those ideas to be in the final version of the game.
 Any feature that involves user-generated content is subjected to change, which means you need to manage your own creations by carefully reading any changes for each updates and act accordingly. (it's early-access after all)


Once again, I'd like to apologize for being inactive recently. 2020, for me, seems to be better in some ways. Yet with the new virus outbreak, it's hard to predict the future now. Stay safe and enjoy the New Year, since we'll have a lot of splashing to do...

Update v1.690 - code name: FirstPersona - Features
First Person Mode
Fully supports First Person for all characters:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/fd2901829184652d39df2db74361455127764dff.jpg

You can select your preferred camera mode in the Advanced Server Settings menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/b6600a1bd2a262eb0fa1825041c282d4bc5786ca.jpg

There are two types of First Person Camera: Generic and Immersive

 Generic lets you play the game in first-person camera WITHOUT Animation-based Head Swaying. This is recommended for people with slight Motion Sickness.
 Immersive lets you play the game in first-person camera WITH Animation-based Head Swaying. This is recommended for people who want... well... total immersion.


Those settings are per-server in order to keep the experience balanced for all players in that server.

Ammo Management
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/f7762684702ed5e04dc5ff54ab3c4310bc739164.jpg

Up to now, all shots are free, player can just shoot, reload and repeat. This is called Default Ammo Management (or No Pool Mode)

From now on, game modes like Team Tactics will support two more way to manage player's ammo: Module Pool and Weapon Pool

 Module Pool lets each of the weapon's modules manage its own ammo pool as if each module is a separate gun. For example, your 1st Sniper Module will have separate ammo pool with your 2nd and 3nd Sniper Module.
 Weapon Pool only lets ALL modules of a weapon share the same ammo pool (that is, the ammo pool of that weapon). For example, if you reload your 1st Sniper Modules, you will also drain the ammo for the entire modules of that Sniper Rifle.


You can see the different here:
No Pool (Default):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/f78b0976e4c7887921c532b317d9cac65cd20dd8.jpg

Module Pool:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/f159946ea05cb80edc21d65afbc7e8ae28df86f3.jpg

Weapon Pool:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/2973078dc0e46053002bac724241a0b8a47f4934.jpg

=> NOTE: There's currently NO WAY to refill your ammo pool, except revivial/reset your character, so be careful with each shot!

Experimental Game Mode: Team Survival
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/3fd303dec4610396cce1c2d1f52806379ae17ebb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/a67841b8049c9ecc52003fb6bc32ead4a788f4f0.jpg

This game mode is an Experimental game mode that allows both Single and Co-op Experiences. The game rules are as follow:

 Player(s) has to clear all the Waves in order to win. (currently 4 Waves)
 Each wave will have a separate objective that player(s) has to fulfil. (at the moment, the  only objective is Take Them All Out - eliminate all enemies)
 Each Wave will have a time limit. Player(s) must complete all the objectives in that Wave before time runs out.
 For each Wave, a player will have an amount of Lives. Runing out of Lives and the Wave is Lost.
 When the Wave is Lost, player(s) can retry the Wave again by spending Continue point. Running out of Continue point means Total Defeat for the entire Mode, and the Mode will Restart.
 It is recommended to play this mode with Weapon Pool Enabled.
 It is recommended to keep the number of players NO GREATER THAN 4. (this will be capped in the future)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/580a020ec33adde9b591fa5cdb05ce93697febc1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/57d69d21496ab6ca327d6d75a9917acd4c4c4d01.jpg

Experimental Character Modding
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31386060/f82c11ca9960f0007b067946637be64d533469bb.jpg
Interested in Modding? Well now you can try it out for the first time with Battle Splash's Experimental Modding Feature.

Go to Battle Splash's Modding Tool on GitLab and download/pull the lastest version of the Modding Tools there, and follow the instructions there.

=> NOTE: Modding Features are subjected to change. A more detailed tutorial is coming soon.

Others Changes/Updates/Improments
Hardware Breaking Change
Battle Splash No Longer supports DX9.0c due to its limitations. Please updates your driver accordingly.
Deprecating 32-bit versions
With the release of Modding Tool, the 32-bit version of Battle Splash will suffer from massive memory shortage in order to maintain the high-quality settings for the game and the mods. Therefore, Battle Splash will slowly move to 64-bit ONLY systems. There's currently no hard date yet, but please be prepared for it.
Animations Update
Added Firing animations for each guns, also smoother animation transitions.
Performance Update
As always, faster and more stable gameplay.
Neworking Update
Networked game will be much smoother than before.

Known Issues
Game Breaking-bugs
Playing Battle Splash at the same map for too long may potentially crash the game.
Game Logic-bugs
Sometimes some value will be out of sync in a Networked game.
Animations
Some animations will be "rough", expecting fixes in the future.

notes.title: Update v1.688 - Graphics, Experience, and Performance Enhancement
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it's been a while! 

As for us, Vietnamese, the New Year only began from the last month. Thus, I decided to make a fresh start to this Lunar New Year by reworking on various graphical features of Battle Splash in order to enhance overall experience of the game. Check it out!

Splash Distortion Update
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/67ccdb96c6729d1f4ff65a7bf22a39698a9dfd15.jpg

Distortion Effect is added to Big Splashes, allow a better visual representation of the water explosion's impact. This also helpful for detecting incoming splashes.

Shell Drops
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/ae0e41a66bfee6d8f5ecf79993ddce8ba00ffeb7.jpg

Some of you thought Battle Splash was a Squirt gun shootout. Turns out, it's more than that. Battle Splash's Guns actually shoot out bullet (in a form of spherical water balloons) instead of water, so that they can deliver their full splash power to the target. In order to reflect this, Weapons will now drop empty shell upon firing/bolting.

Character's Impact Animation
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/13949ffcf70120a9a0c022fa6d7ccd03a866af50.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/ec629791053bd977bc793d80e6c5653a94b05e0f.jpg

Did you notice that a Bazooka Splash can send your character flying across the map? Yes, it's that powerful, to the point that now your character will suffer from it: Brand new animations for bullets/splashes impact! And yes, it hurts...

Character's visual & Graphic Enhancement
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/662523a30221b86ae4ef40195810be49686f408f.jpg

This version of Battle Splash is HIGHLY OPTIMIZED, thus allowing your computer to apply many Visual features (given that your computer meets the Minimum System Requirement). Try turning on max settings for the FXAA and SSAO to experience the smoothest and pretties gameplay! Go and Feast your eyes:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/ff66ea9feea3f5024ef3ebbac6905a873aca319c.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/b22df13381d61227ccab08fbb97c28664c871672.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/dbdd4ec6f369d1b61eace079a85b7d7ffd865bdb.jpg

Here are the settings:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/ddba5733fb6aadecb7f4b697f3d87ad98e7d1afe.png
(These settings are possible for Recommended System Requirement)

Although, "Eye Adaptation" is now removed since the incompatibility with recents NVidia Drivers. Also, DX9 will be deprecated very soon due to low performance and stability, so please update your GPU to the latest drivers for DX11 support.

Sounds and HUD

In order to adapt to the new gameplay experience, Battle Splash's sounds and HUD are updated accordingly. You can now feel the strength in each of your shoot, as well as get shaken by enemies's incoming projectile.

Breaking Changes

For quite a while now, Battle Splash's been supporting very low spec computers. However, with the game's constant growth and demanding graphics, some backward compatibility will be removed.

First is DX9, the old and glory API. It was good for a while, yet now DX11 has taken its place and prove to be more stable, performance friendly than DX9. In order to fully support high performance experience, DX9 will not receive any support in the future. Of course, you can still play the game in DX9 if you want to, yet the further game's update will now concentrate on DX11 more, meaning playing with DX9 will potentially cause crashes/glitches.

Second is 32bit Operating System. A better graphics means more RAM usage, and 32bit OS just won't allow it. A game can only allocate 2GB of RAM on 32bit OS, so it just won't work. If you are using 64bit OS, 32Bit game can allocate up to 3GB of RAM, which seems better. However, don't get me wrong just yet: the game is still 32bit, it's just that the OS should be 64bit instead. Why you asked? Why don't I just go ahead and build a 64bit version of the game? Because many of you are still using 4GB of RAM. Since 64bit version of the game will likely use more RAM than the 32bit version, it will more likely flood the computer's RAM (more testes are coming out). Therefore, for now Battle Splash will require a minimum of 64bit OS, and the Standard version will still be 32bit. (For Full Modding version, it should be 64bit)


That it for some of the major updates for the game! Happy Splashing! :lunar2019wavingpig:

....... Still wants more? Here is the detailed version of the above:

Battle Splash Update v1.688

 Name: MemOveride
 Version: 1.688
 ContentID: 3609845


New & Improvement

 Animations: New animations for being pushed around by bullets/splashes, etc...
 Gameplay: Highly Optimized gameplay for smoother and more stable frame-rate.
 Gameplay: Improved Aiming.
 Gameplay: Your weapon's modules now manage their own magazine, meaning if you switch to an empty-magazine module, you'll have to reload it again.
 Graphics: Tweaked hair shader.
 Graphics: Custom lighting for character, so that it will react to lighting (Physic-based) while being easier to config (Art-based).
 Graphics: Added distortion effect for splashes explosions/bullet impacts.
 Graphics: Weapon can now drop "empty shells" when bolting/firing.
 Graphics: More nature-looking weapon holster behaviors.
 GUI: Improved 4k resolution.
 HUD: Your camera will be shaken upon getting shot at.


Fixes
 Graphic: Remove Eye Adaptation due to incompatibility with modern graphic cards' drivers. (cause character's hair/eyes to disappear, as well as downgrade the overall graphics)
 Memory: Fixed heap memory leakage. More native memory leakages are being inspected.

notes.title: Battle Splash Discord Server is now Online!

And look at your right to confirm that you're ready for game:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/4cb86ee8aa79387f5f89d990f2346aee19b8b85b.jpg

Now if you want to join other people's games, just click on their account and message them. You can now discuss with them about who will host the game, what server to go to, rules, etc... The rest is just to launch Battle Splash and enjoy!

Happy Splashing! ːsteamhappyː

Battle Splash's Creator
Hung Mai

notes.title: Lunar Update v1.679 - Environment Effect
notes.content:
Hello everyone! ːsteamhappyː

This is the first (and minor) update since the Lunar New Year, which focuses on Optimization and Environment effect.

Grass and ground are now reacting to weapon's projectile: the explosion from the splash or the kinematic energy from the water balloon will make the around dust and grass fly everywhere. Even the tree leaves will fall if you make a splash explosion right at the upper branches. Check out these screenshots:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/686b6c299b7f5242b1dddcfee25cefb371ecfc8f.jpg
Dust surrounding the exploded water balloon.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/8fcb2a1fac85c7da3a846ab46ff6aee37f983b97.jpg
Flying grass.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/a0af9a3f076b07d1888cb84b6524950e2e2ee76c.jpg
The splash's explosion power will determine how far the grass can fly.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/99578668423742283c034fc97cf8f512e8fd9dcd.jpg
Dust and Smoke everywhere!

Additionally, all "balloons" projectiles and splashes can now properly "knock back" other player upon contact/explosion. For example: a sniper rifle direct hit will now knock back the target.

These effects are the first phrase of making a more solid gunplay for Battle Splash, so that you can "feel" the power of your weapons.

Aside from that are some performance optimization, both with RAM and CPU usage, for a smoother gameplay.

Happy Splashing! ːsteamhappyː

Battle Splash's Creator,
Hung Mai

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/300aaa91561a4d208ca9f2b275174f65e2534960.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/d2fe1a12b12c7cf3816de4fabef73c59a53fa237.jpg

Hello everyone! ːsteamhappyː
I'm happy to announce that the next update for Battle Splash is ready. This update focuses mostly on animation visual feedbacks, performance, scene/character rendering quality update, and gameplay. It also features the 3rd Weapon Pack, which heavily relies on bounciness and large ammo capacity, thus leading to a more chaotic water warfare than ever.

Graphics update - New Animation system and Better Scene/Character rendering
This version of Battle Splash replaces almost every existing characters' animations, resulting a better, more lively, and smoother visual feedbacks.
Along with the animations is better lighting for both Scene and Character.

Performance - 32bit returns
This version addresses many performance issues with the previous release, including both memory and CPU/GPU power. Along with the optimization is the return of the 32 bit version of the game: people who previously weren't able to run the game in 32 bit can now start playing again. ːsteamhappyː

However, please note that 32bit version might get deprecated in the future, since backward compatibility is really time-consuming. The DX9 version of the game will be deprecated in the next engine update, so until that day, please make sure that your graphics driver is up-to-date.

Gameplay
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31386060/d253ecbb427e74483ca473944952de30e28e4b2a.jpg
Battle Splash will now feature Air-control for easier air movement. It does not mean you can "move" in the air just like you are running on the ground, but you'll be able to change your jumping direction, or fasten/slow down your speed easier on air. The characters can now rotate in the air for better aiming, and more frenzy gameplay.

The "old" (or "original") Splash mechanic is now featured in the game thanks to the performance update: Bigger splash for Bazooka, looks more like "flowing water" rather than "water explosion". This means the Splashes are more powerful than before, as it can "live" longer and spread wider.

The 3rd Weapon Pack features bouncy balloons and a lot, lot of ammo for every gun. There is currently no 3rd Balloon, yet every other "3rd Pack" weapons will remix the base behaviour even more than the 2nd Weapon Pack. Expect a lot of splashes, and flying balloons!

Battle Splash's Dedicated Server
In about a few days, Battle Splash's Dedicated Server will be released as "Early Access", allows advanced users to host their own game on their own dedicated server(s). Currently, Linux servers are being tested and show very positive results, thus it will be released as soon as the basic documentation for the dedicated servers is completed.

And More
These above are some highlights about the upcoming update of Battle Splash. There are actually some more minor changes with the game that will be listed below, yet you'll have to experience them yourself. Happy Splashing everyone! ːsteamhappyː

Full Release Note

Information:
- Name: Battle Splash Early Access
- Build Alias: FlyingDutchman
- Build Version: 1.676

Improvements:

- Animation: More New/Updated animations (Phrase 2). Character animation is now smoother and more lively.
- Game Mechanics: Air control for better movement on air.
- Game Mechanics: Character can now rotate on air.
- Game Mechanics: Old splash Mechanic was implemented, results in a even more destructive splash.
- Game Mechanics: It's now easier to do balloon hops.
- Game Mechanics: The 3rd Weapon Pack. Featuring a Semi-automatic Rifle, a Semi-automatic Bazooka, and an Automatic Pistol. Every weapons in this pack has increased magazine capacity and bouncing balloons.
- Game Mechanics: Character now slides when their wetness reach 100%. The sliding speed and direction are based-on character's current velocity as well as the collided balloon(s)'s velocity(es).
- Game Performance: Improve even more Speed and Stable Frame-rate. Reduce memory usage.
- Visual: Better scene/character lighting.

Changes:
- Game Mechanics: Reduce the range of the 2nd Bazooka.

Fixes:
- Game Performance: 32 bit version is now supported and playable.
